thread.title: Apple (AAPL) Stock Rating Lowered by Loop Capital

author: ABMN Staff
title: Apple (AAPL) Stock Rating Lowered by Loop Capital
text:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was downgraded by equities researchers at Loop Capital from a “buy” rating to a “hold” note issued to investors
Several other analysts also recently commented on the stock. Wells Fargo & Co reissued a “hold” rating on shares of Apple in a research report on Thursday. Piper Jaffray Companies cut their price objective on shares of Apple from $222.00 to $187.00 and set an “overweight” rating on the stock in a research report on Thursday. Macquarie downgraded shares of Apple from an “outperform” research report on Thursday. UBS Group set a $180.00 price objective on shares of Apple and gave the company a “buy” report on Thursday. Finally, Goldman Sachs Group set a $140.00 price objective on shares of Apple and gave the company a “neutral” report on Thursday. Three research analysts have rated twenty-five have given a hold rating and twenty-one have issued a buy rating to the stock. The company presently has an average rating of “Hold” and a consensus price target of $209.77.
